semantic.justification: Task AQF9AG maps the ScImportOptions CSV filter-string contract to the existing Calc export path. Its native short-string DONTKNOW encoding/defaults, legacy four-token behavior, recognized fourteen-token positions, delimiter weighting, surplus-token tolerance and signed32 numeric token parsing are represented. Encoding conversion and Calc export are owned by their source-aligned SAL and ScDocShell modules; formatter-driven date/currency classification remains incomplete and is not claimed as parity.
